VCCA is a deep multi-view model that can learn the common information underlying two views of data without supervision and VCCA-private is a variant of VCC that can learn the shared and private variables underlying two views of the data without supervision.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a deep learning approach for canonical correlation analysis (CCA) and demonstrate its effectiveness on a wide range of multi-view learning tasks, including dimension reduction, representation learning, and disentanglement of private and common information.

VCCA can be viewed as a generalization of multi-view autoencoder~\citep{Tzeng2014DeepAM}, and that VCCA-private can be viewed as an alternative to the multi-view disentanglement model~\citep{khemakhem2020variational}.
, VCCA is a generalization of linear CCA, VCCA-private is a generalization for the linear CCA with private variable, and our work can be seen as a generalization of deep auto-encoders.
The main takeaway from our work is that
VCCA and its variants are capable of learning deep nonlinear multi-view representations with a principled probabilistic formulation.
deep generative models, when combined with variational inference, can serve as powerful tools for multi-view learning and data disentanglement.
VCCA is an effective tool for learning nonlinear representations of multi-view data, and can also be used for extracting the shared and private variables from multi-view data.
